Name: Big Fridges
Author: AlanBF
Description:
[size=4][b]About[/b][/size]

What the mod does:

1. Makes the fridge in the Farm House and Ginger Island House be a 70 spaces fridge. (Same as a Big Chest)
2. Allows you to buy a Big Fridge from Robin, after your second House upgrade (or first upgrade and 5 hearths with her)
3. Can put the Big Fridge on top o a Mini-Fridge to replace, the same as a Chest -> Big Chest
4. Adds a Color Picker for Mini-Fridges and Big Fridges

[size=4][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
HouseFridgeProgressive:
[list]
[*]true: First house upgrade has a Mini-Fridge, second upgrade have a Big Fridge.
[*]false: Always a big fridge in the house.
[/list]ItemFridgeWithHearths:
[list]
[*]true: Buy Big Fridges after the first house upgrade and a few hearths with Robin.
[*]false: Can only buy after the second house upgrade.
[/list]HearthsWithRobin:
[list]
[*]Number of hearths needed with Robin for unlock early (House Upgrade 1 + x hearths)
[/list]Price:
[list]
[*]Price
[/list]

[size=4][b]Compatibility[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11115]Better Crafting[/url]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9791]Better Chest[/url], needs to configure the fridges properly (allow color picker and disable sizing).
[/list]
